text: {"us_status":"not found","label_product":"TAGRISSO (osimertinib) tablets, for oral use","label_version_or_date":"DailyMed updated September 14, 2026; Recent Major Changes 09/2026","label_section":"Not found in current U.S. prescribing information (DailyMed text search found no 'hepatitis', 'hepat', or 'reactivation').","quote":"","eu":"EMA/PRAC: HBV reactivation added/recommended as SmPC 4.4 warning and 4.8 undesirable effect, frequency not known; current EMA product information includes the HBV warning.","uk":"UK MHRA/eMC: current UK SmPC for TAGRISSO, last updated 24 Sep 2026, includes HBV reactivation in section 4.4 and as an infection/infestation adverse reaction in section 4.8, frequency not known.","us_regulator":"FDA: no HBV-reactivation public evaluation found for Tagrisso/osimertinib in AEMS/FAERS potential-signal materials searched; FDA has a different public Tagrisso/EGFR-TKI signal, radiation recall phenomenon, with no action needed.","sources":["https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=5e81b4a7-b971-45e1-9c31-29cea8c87ce7","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/prac-recommendation/prac-recommendations-signals-adopted-1-4-september-2025-prac-meeting_en.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/product-information/tagrisso-epar-product-information_en.pdf","https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-product-information-about-medicines","https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/7615/smpc","https://www.fda.gov/drugs/fda-adverse-event-monitoring-system-aems/new-safety-information-or-potential-signals-serious-risks-identified-fda-adverse-event-monitoring","https://www.fda.gov/drugs/fda-adverse-event-monitoring-system-aems/july-september-2022-potential-signals-serious-risksnew-safety-information-identified-fda-adverse"]}
